description: This file contains automated tests for Git's atomic push feature, using shell scripting to set up repositories, perform pushes, and verify expected behavior under various scenarios, including hooks, failure modes, and push options.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Sets up a pair of repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench' for testing, configuring the upstream repo to warn on current branch updates and adding 'upstream' as remote in 'workbench'.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the specific refs between upstream and workbench repositories to verify they match.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of git push to only include lines starting with 'To' or lines indicating rejected refs, simplifying status reporting.
